verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a first-party Connector Builder, a no-code UI layered on its low-code YAML format. It lets you develop a custom connector and use it in syncs without leaving the workspace, with AI-assisted prefill and incremental sync support, so no fork is needed. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building a long-tail API connector with the Builder.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I build a custom connector for a long-tail API with a supported framework or low-code builder, not a fork

citations.quote: letting you develop a connector to use in data syncs without ever needing to leave your Airbyte workspace.
Connector Builder is a no-code tool that’s part of the Airbyte UI. It provides an intuitive user interface on top of the low-code YAML format
When starting a new connector, AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder
An incremental sync is a sync which pulls only the data that has changed since the previous sync
